<div class="card-body">
'''Commander Evram Lajaie''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊イヴラム・ラジャイ少佐</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィン4、ホス、またはエンドアの位置カードに彼が配備されていれば、反乱軍の宇宙船はその星系に“リアクション”として移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Commander-Evram-Lajaie-SWCA-67692.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">宇宙防衛態勢、とりわけ軌道上での戦闘を専門とする著名なリーダー。彼のおかげで、同盟軍はデス・スターの構造上の弱点を発見できた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Commander Evram Lajaie.

'''Card text:'''
If he is deployed at a Yavin 4, Hoth, or Endor location card, Rebel starships may move to that system as a "react."

'''Lore:'''
A well-known leader who specializes in space defense, especially orbital battle. Thanks to him, the Alliance found a structural weakness in the Death Star.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese reacts to that system from a location card; the English from a site to the related system.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Commander Evram Lajaie]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
